thread:
ana: Legal just requested that Support run a DSAR extraction job for a customer. They want a temporary analytics role but cannot have decrypt rights or direct PII access. Need RBAC + audit + retention plan. tagging @sam @vikram.
sam: Can we do a query-only role against a masked view and ensure no KMS decrypt? Minimal perms only.
vikram: Yes. Plan: create role `analytics_dsar_reader` with SELECT on `analytics_view_masked` and S3 read-only on `s3://redwood-analytics/masked/`. No kms:Decrypt. Enforce view-layer redaction for email/ssn.
ana: Legal asked that every DSAR extraction attach the DSAR ticket id to logs and record a proof artifact of the returned dataset. Audit entries must include dsar_id, query_hash, masking_version.
lisa: Current access logs don't hold dsar_id. We need a logging path that emits structured events to SIEM. I can own the schema.
sam: I'll add a lightweight logging middleware in the query service that emits JSON to Splunk. Example payload (literal): ```{"dsar_id":"DSAR-2025-042","actor":"svc_analytics","query_hash":"sha256:abcd...","masking_version":"v2","proof_blob_id":"pb-789"}```
vikram: KMS stance: role gets ZERO decrypt permissions. Any plaintext access requires breakglass: two approvers (security + legal), time-limited creds (1h), auto-revoke, and session recording. Breakglass creates a keystore_request_id tied to the audit entry.
ana: Breakglass flow: approvals over PagerDuty + Slack, record timestamp, approver IDs, and store proof blob. All artifacts linked to keystore_request_id.
lisa: Retention question: Product wants DSAR proof logs for 365d; security prefers 90d for general access logs. Suggestion?
sam: Compromise: keep standard access logs at 90d. Store full proof blobs 365d but encrypted into a tightly-scoped bucket `s3://redwood-proof/legal-only/` with a dedicated KMS key accessible only to E-Discovery/legal roles. Audit index stores only `proof_blob_id` and non-sensitive metadata.
vikram: Also insist proof blobs do NOT contain raw PII in plaintext. Store encrypted payload + redaction map + CRC + query_hash. Use customer KMS key for encryption if required, otherwise legal KMS key.
lisa: I'll add SIEM detection rules: alert on any `s3:GetObject` for `proof_blob_*` outside business hours and alert on any `kms:Decrypt` for the legal-proof key from non-legal principals.
privacy-bot: Reminder: open PRIV ticket for retention-exception approval (PRIV-5421) and update privacy-runbook.md.
sam: Implementation plan: 1) Terraform role & IAM policy; 2) query-service logging middleware + Splunk schema; 3) canary tests that try to access raw columns and must fail; 4) runbook + approval flow docs. ETA PR by EOD tomorrow.
vikram: Draft IAM snippet for discussion:
```
resource "aws_iam_role" "analytics_dsar_reader" {
  name = "analytics_dsar_reader"
  assume_role_policy = jsonencode({/* trust for svc account */})
}
resource "aws_iam_policy" "analytics_dsar_policy" {
  name = "analytics_dsar_policy"
  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17",
    Statement = [
      {
        Effect = "Allow",
        Action = ["s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket"],
        Resource = ["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-analytics/masked/*"]
      },
      {
        Effect = "Deny",
        Action = ["kms:Decrypt"],
        Resource = ["*"]
      }
    ]
  })
}
```
lisa: Add SIEM rule to warn if `analytics_dsar_reader` tries to query non-masked columns or access `s3://redwood-analytics/unmasked/`.
ana: I'll CC Legal on the infra PR and flag the retention compromise (90d index, 365d encrypted proof artifacts) for signoff. After PR lands we'll run the canary and close the loop.
sam: I'll draft the runbook and include an automated negative test that attempts to select raw PII and must fail.
vikram: One more ask: include `masking_version` in audit events so we can prove which redaction logic was applied. Also include `proof_blob_checksum` to ensure immutability.
lisa: noted. I'll update schema and create the Splunk dashboard for DSAR audit.
privacy-bot: Action items: open PRIV-5421, attach proposed IAM, Splunk schema, and sample proof blob format.
ana: Thanks team 44d I'll open the PR and link PRIV-5421 in the description.
